Name: Machine Upgrade System - Translation Pack QLS
Author: 17SunAndMoon17
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#4D79FF]Machine Upgrade System - Translation Pack QLS
[/color][/b][/size][size=4][color=#A3A3A3]High-Quality Translations for tlitookilakin/swyrl's Framework Mod[/color][/size][/center]Welcome to the [b]Translation Pack QLS [/b]for the innovative "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33024]Machine Upgrade System[/url]" mod (created by tlitookilakin, published by swyrl)! This page provides meticulously crafted translations, enabling a broader audience to utilize this powerful framework in their preferred language.
[size=5][b][color=#80BFFF]
About the Base Mod (Created by tlitookilakin)
[/color][/b][/size]"[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33024]Machine Upgrade System[/url]" is a framework mod that introduces a flexible system for adding drop-in upgrades to machines and potentially other items within Stardew Valley.
[size=4][b]
Base Mod Features:
[/b][/size][list][*] [b]Framework Core:[/b] Allows modders to easily define new upgrade paths for items.
[*] [b]Default Upgrades Included:[/b] Comes with six standard upgrade tiers out-of-the-box: Steel, Gold, Diamond, Iridium, Radioactive, and Prismatic.
[*] [b]Flexible Application:[/b] Upgrades can be applied directly to placed machines in the world or conveniently within the inventory by right-clicking the upgrade onto the target item.
[*] [b]Automation Friendly:[/b] Compatible with popular automation mods like Hoppers, Automate, and Junimatic for seamless integration into your farm setup.
[*] [b]Clear Tooltips:[/b] Items that can be upgraded will indicate this in their description tooltip, often showing which upgrade item is needed.
[/list][i]For full technical details and modder documentation, please refer to the original mod page and its linked resources.

[/i][size=5][b][color=#80BFFF]Languages Available in this Pack:[/color][/b][/size]
This QLS Pack provides translations for the user-facing text of the framework (like tooltips and UI elements) into the following languages:[list][*]Spanish (es)
[*]Portuguese (pt)
[*]German (de)
[*]French (fr)
[*]Russian (ru)
[*]Japanese (ja)
[*]Korean (ko)
[*]Italian (it)
[*]Turkish (tr)
[*]Hungarian (hu)
[/list][color=yellow][i](Note: The base mod already includes English and Chinese.)
[/i][/color][size=5][b][color=#80BFFF]
Requirements[/color][/b][/size][list][*]The original [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33024]Machine Upgrade System[/url][/b] mod (Created by tlitookilakin, Published by swyrl).
[*] [b]ALL dependencies[/b] required by the original "Machine Upgrade System" mod. Please verify these on the original mod page.
[/list][color=orange][b]Ensure the base mod is installed and working correctly *before* adding this translation pack.
[/b][/color][size=5][b][color=#80BFFF]
Installation Instructions[/color][/b][/size][color=red][b]
!! VERY IMPORTANT: YOU MUST INSTALL THE ORIGINAL MOD *FIRST* !!
[/b][/color]
Download the original mod here:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33024]Machine Upgrade System
[/url][b]
Ensure[/b] you have the original "Machine Upgrade System" mod installed correctly.
[list=1][*]Choose your download option from the [b]"Files"[/b] tab of [u][b]THIS PAGE[/b][/u]:   
[list]    [*] [b]Individual Language File:[/b] (e.g., `Spanish.zip`, `German.zip`). Contains only the selected language.   
[/list][/list][list=1]
[list]
[*] [b]QLS Full Pack:[/b] (`QLS_full_pack.zip`). Contains all languages from this pack in one download.   
[/list][/list][list=1]
[*]Unzip the downloaded file. Inside, you will find a folder named `MachineUpgradeSystem`.
[*]This `MachineUpgradeSystem` folder contains an `i18n` subfolder with the translation file(s) (e.g., `es.json`, `de.json`, etc.).
[*]Navigate to your main `Stardew Valley/Mods` folder and locate the [b]original[/b] `MachineUpgradeSystem` folder you installed previously.
[*]Copy the `MachineUpgradeSystem` folder you extracted from [b]this pack's download[/b] ([b]Step 2[/b]).
[*]Paste the copied folder directly into your main `Stardew Valley/Mods` folder. [b]This action needs to overwrite/merge with the original mod's folder.[/b]
[*]Your operating system [b]WILL ask[/b] if you want to merge folders and/or replace existing files within the `i18n` directory. You [b][color=red]MUST[/color][/b] select [color=red][b]YES / MERGE / REPLACE ALL[/b][/color] for all prompts. This correctly adds the new translation files to the original mod's structure.
[*]Launch Stardew Valley via SMAPI. Ensure your game language is set correctly. The translated tooltips and UI elements from the mod should now appear.
[/list][size=4][b]File Structure Note:
[/b][/size]Each downloaded `.zip` file (whether individual or the full pack) contains a `MachineUpgradeSystem` folder. Inside *that* folder is the `i18n` folder which holds the actual translation `.json` file(s). You need to ensure this `i18n` folder gets merged correctly into the original mod's structure in your Mods Directory.
[size=5][b][color=#80BFFF]
Compatibility[/color][/b][/size][list=1][*] This translation pack only provides translation files (`.json` files within the `i18n` folder structure).
[*] It is designed to be fully compatible with the base "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33024]Machine Upgrade System[/url]" mod.
[*] It does not alter game mechanics or add new items; its sole function is to translate existing text strings provided by the framework. It should not inherently conflict with other mods.

[/list][size=5][b][color=#80BFFF]Credits[/color][/b][/size][list][*] A massive thank you to [b]tlitookilakin[/b] for creating the powerful and versatile "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33024]Machine Upgrade System[/url]" framework, and to [b]swyrl[/b] for publishing and maintaining it on Nexus Mods! All credit for the mod's core concept and functionality belongs entirely to the creator. [i]Please visit and endorse the mod page published by swyrl![/i]
[/list][i]
[/i][list]
[*] Translations provided by myself ([b]17SunAndMoon17[/b]) and the collaborative team behind the [b]Translation Pack QLS [/b]We aim to make great mods accessible to more players![/list]
